notes.title: Fallen Knight Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Hope everyone is staying healthy and well! After speaking with the community and receiving feedback we have made some adjustments to Lancelot's heal! For more details do read below.

Fallen Knight Patch 1.05 Update

 Lancelot is now allowed to heal himself whilst moving and holding the heal button (applies after ≈2.5 secs). This applies to all movement; running, dashing, jumping, wall running, etc. 
 Idle/sitting healing speed has been reduced from 2 secs to 1.5 secs (Focus Heal has been adjusted as well).
 Reduced "Double Heal" unlock criteria from 500HP to 50HP.
 Fixed and improved Japanese localization.
 Fixed bug where previously players are unable to press any button at the "Results" screen after defeating Lucifer.


Still finding bugs? Help report them ♥

notes.title: HotFix Patch 1.0.1 LIVE
notes.content:
Hi everyone! ♥

Thank you for your patience and support. Please find the Hotfix Patch 1.0.1 now LIVE and ready for your game to be updated!

Hotfix Patch 1.0.1

 Added “No Damage” checkpoint at every Boss room (Players who get through a stage without taking any damage and reach the Boss room will retain “No Damage” status saved at the checkpoint)
 Adjusted Boss Parry & Disarm tutorial screen (5 seconds to read the information before entering Boss room)
 Fixed controller input lag / delay
 Fixing issue with UI shown for Wrath of God in the tutorial
 Fixed Juggernaut’s level where some players were unable to climb the wall on the left
 Fixed when restarting in the Juggernaut level some players would fall through the map
 Fixed Whisper’s level where some platforms cannot be climbed by players
 Fixed Pierrot, Strike and drones that always shoot projectiles towards the floor
 Fixed Driller enemy charge attack speed (before was very slow)
 Fixed where after completing the game and the credits the cutscene didn't show
 Fixed "Purchase" button in the shop (previous was small)
 Fixed where "
" shows up in some texts
 Fixed the SFX bug where the sound still played after being turned off
 Fixed Chain Assassination 2.0 and Chain 2.0 (Previously, players were sometimes unable to execute the move)
 Fixed Wrath of God 1.0/20 (previously was unable to be purchased and also disappears in the customization tab)
 Fixed Boss Rush Mode, best time won't reset after deleting save file
 Fixed issue with achievements (Players that purchase all abilities/Golden Knight now receive Excalibur)
 Fixed Golden Knight achievement description
 Fixed conditions of Excalibur
 Fixed Strike where sometimes after when he starts his dash he would suddenly stop
 Fixed Successor skill cost (previously different cost in Main Story and Boss Rush Mode)
 Fixed Galahad’s bug where he was unable to move when his dagger hits an enemy or boss
 Fixed Pierrot and Nikolai (Previously, the bosses sometimes get stuck during the boss fights)
 Improved Strike’s and Lucifer’s move set during the boss fights
 Improved the Parry & Disarm mechanic (Increased the time window to parry the enemy’s attacks)

notes.title: Introducing, Nikolai The Rogue Knight!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/0ef9a7ec00dcb74bebdd7eb0780e497d944de99d.png

During Next Fest, players were able to download our demo for a limited time. Those who has the chance to play Fallen Knight were confronted with the Rogue Knight, Nikolai! A challenging quest even before reaching his lair, you must be fast inside the mines, the ceilings can be very unstable...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/3282298d8d138d9c55a4cfab90e55e458e9f4d09.gif

Night Of Knights

Deep within the Orichalcum Mines resides the traitor Knight, Nikolai. Surrounded by scorching magma, you must defeat this treacherous foe! Nikolai turned his back against the Cathedral, he could not watch while the other Knights enslaved people. Abandoning the Knights Code one bloody night, he never looked back, and did what he believes needed to be done...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/67c0c7ccdf926df98179e61de554e8c9e051bee5.gif

Too Hot Too Handle

Keep your wits about you with this boss, he wields a powerful mace with a force strong enough to disturb the flow of lava to whichever direction he chooses, so a well timed dodge won't go amiss! With impeccable concentration you'll no doubt have Nikolai kneeling on this battlefield, but it won't be easy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/dc7b86c9f9a969fc65bbe59bcba766dfb14ed1b7.gif

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

Make sure to keep up to date with Fallen Knight by adding to your wishlist on steam, or by  visiting our website.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1378370/Fallen_Knight/

notes.title: Gameplay Mechanics, Combat!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png


Basic Attacks

Lancelot's missions often start by fighting his way through masses of enemies to reach his goal. Using his basic attack combo can have a devastating effect. Normal attack is a powerful and fast strike, followed by a jump attack and slash is a sure way to win each encounter!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/ebd3f641016d5c374cc9db40968282fb213b2f94.gif


Counter, Parry & Disarm

A battle technique only the strongest of knights can master! Wait for the enemy to attack first, and with a well timed strike, disarm or parry neutralising  your opponent. Slice rockets out of the air, or deflect bullets at insane speeds!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/3fb0aa725a47e953ce8173fd6bd27c6387c8a4f3.gif


Wrath Of God

A technique from the Gods themselves, a catastrophic attack which allows you to defeat multiple enemies at once. Once your Wrath of God meter is fully charged, let loose your fury!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/512ddc51ea7d7df8e8b0d2760c650c275b55b68f.gif

notes.title: Introducing Strike, The Black Lightning!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/eadacf87b562fe650a45e71c8d856e606c29e6f5.gif


Prepare Yourself!

Lightning fast and a specialist in close quarters combat, Strike puts an end to his opponents before they even notice. Rumoured to be a former champion, and now notorious as a merciless demon, he is an elite member of enemy forces, The Purge.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d0021b269d003792f1c83b81e942cd81b993fd51.gif


The Art Of Parrying

Collect your honour points for this battle, dodging Strike's attacks won't be an easy feat. You must match his speed with a well placed parry, giving you a small window to attack! Fight atop a run-away train headed for disaster in this rapid brawl of legends!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/72fbbf96cd8e53f3f70a1028b9191a48511a532a.gif

notes.title: Introducing Emo Walker Pierrot!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/acfdf23b8dda14cdf18d3f715993a83f5efc61bd.gif


Trick Or Treat!

Known underground as the Code Breaker, Pierrot is a dark and sinister mystery clad in neon lights. A trickster by nature, he will manipulate your very surroundings to secure his win. You must be vigilant in defeating this foe and have faith in your abilities! Parry his lightening-fast attacks, jump, dash and dodge, or succumb to his flashing deadly darts.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/5cbd9e9b3aa841565ac706116b82eae3ce82b78d.gif


The Code Breaker

Little is known about his past, but Pierrot is severely disabled, a result of surviving bouts of heinous torture at the hands of his foes. He now wears a suit fashioned from the Knights' very own Holy Technology, and carries an evil force within him thirsty for revenge.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/22789d5efaaca4afe78973cd9e91068429b23e6e.gif


Kill Or Disarm?

Choose to kill or skilfully parry and disarm enemies. Exhibiting the mercy and honour expected of the Round Table is more difficult, but will earn you valuable 'honour points', and even unlock multiple alternate endings!

notes.title: Futuristic Side-Scroller Fallen Knight Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/f2bc54cbb77043a5b469acd49b9806aa1c45306e.png

In this fast-paced futuristic knights tale, play as the descendant of the fabled Sir Lancelot in an armoured throw-down of the ages to shield your city from The Purge.

Lancelot the 50th has sworn an oath to protect the 'truth' from an evil organisation and must face off against six unique enemy heroes with a dark past of their own.

Introducing 'The Juggernaught' - The Lord Of Blast

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/d254d2b76d98e336f022fba9318adcca55550747.gif

A tough opponent - you must use everything you've learned to conquer this enemy. 
Dash, jump & slash your way to success with lightening-fast reflexes. Landing a well timed dodge is key to defeating this challenger, use your agility to contrast his brute strength.

Earn honour points to upgrade your abilities, health and attacks. This can be a crucial tactic to obtain your success and become unstoppable!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/a6e500e0edfb4549772a92904f1d27a49a65880a.gif

All is not what it seems with your opponents, learn about their past and motives as you cut your way through your quest and uncover the reality of The Purge.

Each boss is a unique battle, master your techniques and achieve the honour & glory worthy of a knight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/45897cdb73ae16411d42bf8653529fb6ede15c1c.gif

Stay tuned for more updates and insights into the lore and mechanics of Fallen Knight!

Make sure to keep up to date with Fallen Knight by adding to your wishlist on steam, or by  visiting our website.

Fallen Knight will be coming to PC on 23rd June, 2021.

notes.title: See the Fallen Knight announcement trailer!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/c0cbf575d010bc53bc0008c284de2c0f6a72c7a8.png

Hey Steam friends,

Did you get a chance to see our announcement trailer? We're extremely excited to show you some Fallen Knight action ahead of our 2021 release! Keep an eye out for future Steam updates too, as we continue to break down some of the mechanics and story elements which make Fallen Knight so unique! 

[previewyoutube=qkcIyzgKdXo;full][/previewyoutube]

What is Fallen Knight?
Fallen Knight is a futuristic knight’s tale that lets players play as a descendant of the great Lancelot in King Arthur’s tale. Take the role of this elite knight and battle your way through action-packed levels with intense sword fighting gameplay in this neo-classic side scrolling action platformer. Save the city from a deadly terrorist organisation hell-bent on exposing the truth you were sworn to protect.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38546891/4819542e07f1d4caf6495ecbf0cc62c153268555.png
